coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 8 ground-truth variable items (38%, rounded): consistent R² evaluation, an 80% development/20% test split, and the 26 car-design parameters. Training sizes and model architectures overlap only partially with the required settings.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Omits the fixed CSV path and the explicit Fastback-only versus combined-dataset comparison. Uses different training-size levels, omitting 60% and 80%. Omits AutoGluon and a distinct GradientBoosting model while adding unrelated architectures. Prioritizes RMSE and uses 10 replicas rather than reporting average R² with confidence intervals over 20 splits.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the expected improvement with increasing training size and the model-specific findings that AutoGluon performs well in the single-design scenario while LightGBM excels on the combined dataset.
